trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.summary: Pops by itself once the other 54 are earned: one playthrough, single-player only, roughly 200 hours.

steps.text: All 54 other trophies are single-player. The list has no online, multiplayer or DLC trophy.
Plan on one playthrough of about 200 hours. There is no New Game+ and no mission replay, so rotate manual saves (15 slots plus one autosave) and keep one at the start and end of every chapter.
Leave cheats off for the whole run: while one is active, trophies and saving are both disabled.
Order of work: story first (doing the Chapter 1 meditation), then side characters and collectibles, then the 100% checklist and leftovers.

disagree.text: Time to platinum: PowerPyx and KeenGamer say about 200 hours; GameTrek says 100 to 200; Playhub says over 200.

trophies.guide:
In short: Pops by itself once the other 54 are earned: one playthrough, single-player only, roughly 200 hours.

2. Plan on one playthrough of about 200 hours. There is no New Game+ and no mission replay, so rotate manual saves (15 slots plus one autosave) and keep one at the start and end of every chapter. [1][2][4]
3. Leave cheats off for the whole run: while one is active, trophies and saving are both disabled. [1][2][4]
4. Order of work: story first (doing the Chapter 1 meditation), then side characters and collectibles, then the 100% checklist and leftovers. [1][2]

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableWhy: GTABase says nothing on the 100% list is missable, but also that a handful of optional tasks expire during the story. Only 100 are needed and PowerPyx says more exist.

trophies.summary: Gold for 100%. The checklist appears after the story; most categories need about 70-80%, a few need everything.

steps.text: The checklist only shows after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), but anything done earlier already counts.
The main story is worth 50%; optional tasks 6%; gang operations 3%; every other line 1-2%.
Needs all of: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loans, 8 vaults, 42 shooting golds, 42 drone time trials, 15 Bret's Target Decks and 33 Underwater Discoveries.

Needs part of: 300/397 stunts, 70/80 challenges, 200/277 vehicles scanned, 100/255 animals studied, 15/18 card sets, 15/18 meditations, 30/34 magazines, 100/125 Cocaine Flamingos, 90/100 hoops, 100 optional tasks.
Take every valuable on a gang operation the first time: they respawn slowly.

disagree.text: Time for 100%: GTABase says 100-120 hours, PowerPyx about 100 hours. PowerPyx adds that the checklist is about 60% of true completion.
